# Fannon Property Services LLC

> Fannon Property Services LLC is a locally owned and insured property care company based in Annapolis, Maryland, working for homes and businesses in Anne Arundel County and on Kent Island.

Lawn and landscape care, pressure washing and house washing, gutter cleaning, yard drainage, Christmas lights (from $650 for a single-story home with lights on the front roofline) and commercial property care with snow and ice management. Free estimates: call or text (443) 223-8643.

## Guides

- [How Many Feet of Christmas Lights Does Your House Need?](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/christmas-lights/measure-your-roofline/index.md): How many feet of Christmas lights does a house need? Add up, in feet, every edge you want lit: the front roofline, both sloped edges of each peak, any side and back rooflines, and the garage or porch roof. A 44 foot front, 28 feet of peak edges and a 22 foot garage roof come to 94 feet. We hang Christmas lights across Anne Arundel County.
- [Christmas Light Clips for Shingles and Gutters: What Holds](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/christmas-light-clips-shingles-gutters/index.md): What clips should you use to hang Christmas lights on shingles and gutters? Plastic clips that hook over the gutter lip, or grip the shingle edge where there is no gutter, never nails, staples or screws. IKO and CertainTeed, two roofing makers, both say a hole through roofing can leak, and IKO adds that holes in fascia can rot. We hang Christmas lights around Annapolis.
- [Fall Yard Cleanup Checklist: What to Do and When in Maryland](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/fall-yard-checklist/index.md): What yard work should I do in the fall in Maryland? Aerate and seed by mid-October, clean the gutters, plant shrubs, clear thick leaf cover and mow until the grass stops growing. Grass seed takes about 2 weeks to sprout. Leaf removal falls in late October to mid-November. The last mow may come in late November.
- [How Deep Should Mulch Be? Adding New Mulch Over Old](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/how-deep-should-mulch-be/index.md): How thick should a layer of mulch be around trees and shrubs? Mulch should be laid 2 to 3 inches deep, and never more than 3. Keep it about 3 inches back from tree trunks, never touching bark. Boxwood and other shallow-rooted plants get 1 inch at most. Over old mulch, add only enough to reach that depth again.
- [How Often Should Gutters Be Cleaned? Twice a Year](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/how-often-to-clean-gutters/index.md): How many times a year do gutters need cleaning? Gutters should be cleaned about twice a year, in spring and again in early fall, and any time they clog. With the debris cleared out, rain can flow down the downspout and away from the house. A clogged gutter can overflow and pour water in front of a basement window or along the foundation.
- [Maryland Lawn Care Calendar: When to Start and Stop Mowing](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/maryland-lawn-calendar/index.md): How long is the grass cutting season in Maryland? The grass cutting season in Maryland starts in spring, March to April, and can run to late November. Those dates are for tall fescue, cut at 3 to 4 inches. We mow lawns in Annapolis and across Anne Arundel County, and estimates are free.
- [Mulch Leaves or Rake Them? What Maryland Lawns Need](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/mulch-leaves-or-rake/index.md): Is it better to mulch leaves or rake them? Mow over the leaves on the mower's highest setting, twice if needed; a layer up to about 6 inches deep can be chopped in. If grass shows afterward, leave the bits to feed the soil. Where a mat still hides it, rake off the extra. In Maryland, clear heavy leaf cover late October to mid-November.
- [Standing Water in Your Yard: Causes and Fixes in Maryland](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/standing-water-in-yard/index.md): How long should water sit in a yard after rain? As a rule of thumb, give standing water 24 to 36 hours to soak in, unless it is causing new damage, such as water indoors, soil eroding at a foundation, or water over a driveway or patio. If the water is still there after that, check the downspouts, the low spots and how packed the soil is.
- [What Clogged Gutters Cause: Basement Water, Rot and Ice](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/what-happens-if-gutters-are-clogged/index.md): What damage can clogged gutters do to a house? Clogged gutters spill roof water at the wall, where a few inches of rain can mean several thousand gallons. The soil soaks, water can wick into the basement and lead to mold and rot, and in winter a gutter full of ice can add to an ice dam. We clean gutters around Annapolis, and estimates are free.
- [When to Aerate and Overseed a Lawn in Maryland](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/when-to-aerate-and-overseed/index.md): When should I aerate and overseed my lawn in Maryland? Aerate and overseed a tall fescue lawn from mid-August to mid-October. Most Maryland lawns are mainly tall fescue. Get the seed down by mid-October. It takes about 2 weeks to sprout, and a killing frost in November can damage young grass.
- [Where Should Downspouts Drain, and How Far From the House?](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/where-should-downspouts-drain/index.md): How far should downspouts extend from the house? At least 5 feet from the foundation, letting the water out onto ground that slopes away from the house. A buried pipe should carry it 10 feet or more, to a dry well or other catchment. The ground itself should fall half an inch per foot for 10 feet. We clean gutters around Annapolis, so water reaches the downspout.
- [Yard Waste and Leaf Pickup Rules in Anne Arundel County](https://fannonpropertyservices.com/guides/yard-waste-and-leaf-pickup-rules/index.md): What are the yard waste and leaf pickup rules in Anne Arundel County? Anne Arundel County collects leaves, grass and brush at the curb all year for most households, in paper yard waste bags or a rigid can marked with an X, not plastic bags. Each bag, can or bundle may weigh 40 pounds at most and must be out before 6:00 a.m. on collection day. We do fall leaf removal around Annapolis.
